description: This Java source file defines Swagger API documentation classes for Recurring Deposit Products in the Fineract project, including request and response schemas, nested classes for detailed product attributes, and annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: RecurringDepositProductsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining Swagger schemas for recurring deposit product API requests and responses.

classes.name: PostRecurringDepositProductsRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new recurring deposit product, including nested classes for charts and slabs.

classes.name: PostRecurringDepositProductsResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after creating a recurring deposit product, mainly resource ID.

classes.name: PutRecurringDepositProductsRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating a recurring deposit product, including description and minimum deposit terms.

classes.name: PutRecurringDepositProductsResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after updating a product, including resource ID and changes.

classes.name: GetRecurringDepositProductsResponse
classes.description: Schema for retrieving detailed product information, including nested classes for currency, term types, interest types, accounts, and charts.

classes.name: GetRecurringDepositProductsProductIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for detailed product info by product ID, including nested classes for accounts, interest, fee and penalty mappings, and charts.

classes.name: DeleteRecurringDepositProductsProductIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for delete response, mainly resource ID.
